purpose: Post-hoc mechanism audit of the persistent R4 biology-retention deficit before inspecting frozen R5 outcomes. This audit does not change R4 or R5 and cannot promote either model.

retention_surrogate.probe: affine ridge map from current biological code to ground-truth biological latent
retention_surrogate.probe_fit: detached biological codes from even-numbered calibration identities only
retention_surrogate.gradient_evaluation: odd-numbered diagnostic identities only; probe parameters and calibration normalization detached

interpretation_rule.gradient_conflict_supported: for each renderer, candidate-specific cross+cycle cosine has negative mean and at least 80 percent of checkpoint-by-seed measurements are negative
interpretation_rule.gradient_conflict_not_supported: the above rule is not satisfied; persistent retention loss then cannot be explained as a systematic negative-gradient effect by this audit
